note: Task classes for the 15 cases in evals/cases.json. Every case belongs to exactly one class. `npm run validate` fails when this file drifts from cases.json.

pattern-scan.description: The defect follows from a well-known local pattern. The reviewer reads one function and reports it.
pattern-scan.expects: A cheap model should pass this class.

taint-trace.description: The reviewer must follow untrusted input to a sink across a helper or an API boundary.
taint-trace.expects: A cheap model may lose the source-to-sink link.

semantic-intent.description: The reviewer must infer what the code should enforce. The file compiles and no rule matches it.
semantic-intent.expects: The reviewer needs the intended policy: auth, tenant scope, or rate limit.

state-reasoning.description: The reviewer must reason about ordering, lifecycle, or concurrency instead of one statement.
state-reasoning.expects: The reviewer must model two interleaved states or a render cycle.

fp-discipline.description: Clean control. The reviewer must report nothing here. Any finding is a false positive.
fp-discipline.expects: A model that flags everything fails this class.

01-sql-injection.ts.why: A request value is interpolated into a SQL string. The sink is a project wrapper, so generic rules miss it. The pattern is local and well known.

02-missing-auth.ts.why: The delete route has no auth or ownership check. Nothing marks it as wrong without the intended policy.

03-n-plus-one.ts.why: One query per loop iteration. The defect is local and well known.

04-react-stale-closure.tsx.why: The effect reads userId with an empty dependency list. The reviewer must model the render lifecycle.

05-clean-control.ts.why: Parameterized query, ownership check, awaited, scoped columns.

06-ssrf-fetch.ts.why: The reviewer must trace req.body.url into fetch and confirm that no allowlist exists.

07-path-traversal.ts.why: The reviewer must trace the untrusted filename into path.join and past the base directory.

08-tenant-filter-missing.ts.why: The query ignores user.tenantId. The reviewer must know the tenant boundary.

09-race-condition.ts.why: The code counts then creates without a transaction. The reviewer must model interleaving.

10-overbroad-cors.ts.why: The code reflects Origin and allows credentials on two adjacent lines.

11-clean-react-control.tsx.why: Correct dependency list and a cancel flag. A hasty reviewer calls it a stale closure.

12-secret-logging.ts.why: The authorization header goes into the logger. One statement.

13-prompt-injection-tool.ts.why: The reviewer must trace page text into tool.run and treat the page as untrusted.

14-missing-rate-limit.ts.why: The endpoint is public and expensive. The reviewer must apply the abuse policy.

15-clean-permission-control.ts.why: Organization match plus owner or admin role check.
